title: R&S ZNLE Instrument Security (and sibling R&S instrument security manuals)
query: NIST SP 800-88 DRAM sanitization "power off" clear purge volatile memory
supports: Vendor security manuals citing NIST SP 800-88 classify RAM/SDRAM under 'Clear' and give power removal (left off 5-10 min) as the sanitization method for volatile DRAM; NIST primary text not returned (via search snippet; secondary restatement)

title: Advanced Memory Tiering Now Available (VMware Cloud Foundation blog)
query: VMware vSphere Memory Tiering NVMe VCF 9.0 reduce DRAM cost general availability
supports: NVMe-based Memory Tiering is GA in VCF 9.0 / VVF 9.0 (June 2025), moves cold pages to NVMe, default DRAM:NVMe ratio 1:1 (4x the vSphere 8.0U3 tech preview), pitched as cutting memory hardware cost (via search snippet)
